History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has a 3-day history of mainly watery diarrhea.
Patient denies seeing blood in the stool.
Patient is opening their bowels 6 times per day.
The diarrhea is associated with intermittent, crampy pain in the left lower quadrant (LLQ) with no radiation.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Associated LLQ pain - crampy, intermittent, nil radiation.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has also been vomiting, with no blood in the vomit.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Also vomiting. No blood in vomit.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient had a fever on the first day of illness which has since resolved.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Fever on first day, nil since.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has been feeling lethargic and weak.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Has been feeling lethargic and weak since.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports a loss of appetite.
Patient consumed a takeaway from a Chinese restaurant 4 days ago.
Patient's wife and one child are also unwell with vomiting, but no diarrhea.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Wife and one child also unwell with vomiting, but no diarrhea.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports no other unwell contacts.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient has a history of asthma.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient lives with his wife and children.
The symptoms are affecting the patient's Activities of Daily Living (ADLs).
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Affecting his ADLs as has to be near toilet often.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient has no history of smoking or alcohol use.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised conservative management including rest, increased fluid intake, and paracetamol if feverish.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Conservative management - rest, push fluids, paracetamol if feverish.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient to have a review in 3-5 days if symptoms do not improve.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: To review in 3-5d if symptoms not improving.

Follow_up_Information.content: Advised to seek review earlier if feeling more unwell.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: To see earlier if feeling more unwell.
